name: beforeAfter
title: Before and after
description: Two contrasting states trade places in a split transformation layout.

vanillasky.useWhen: A grounded transformation contrasts an old and new state, manual and automated, or chaos and order.

problemLabel.title: Before label
problemLabel.description: Short uppercase pill label shown above the before headline (12 characters maximum).

problemHeadline.title: Before headline
problemHeadline.description: Headline shown during the before phase. Use 2-5 words and at most 48 characters. Sits centered beneath the BEFORE pill.

solutionLabel.title: After label
solutionLabel.description: Short uppercase pill label shown above the after headline (12 characters maximum).

solutionHeadline.title: After headline
solutionHeadline.description: Headline shown during the after phase. Use 2-5 words and at most 48 characters. Sits centered beneath the AFTER pill.

problemEmojis.title: Before emojis
problemEmojis.description: JSON array of emojis for the chaos / before state (5-8 types, cycled to fill 16 slots distributed around the central text). Example: ["📅", "😰", "💼", "📊", "⏰", "💬", "📞", "🔔"]

solutionEmojis.title: After emojis
solutionEmojis.description: JSON array of emojis for the calm / after state (3-5 types, cycled to fill 16 slots distributed around the central text). Example: ["✨", "📋", "✅", "🎯"]

showEmojis.title: Show decorative emojis
showEmojis.description: Show the animated emoji scatter. Disable for sober financial or editorial comparisons.

vanillasky.label: Before and after
vanillasky.description: Two contrasting states trade places in a split transformation layout.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: The source lacks two distinct states or the comparison depends on exact labeled quantities.
